    # Linear congruential generator: X = (a*X + c) mod m

    c = inputs.get('increment', 2900)
    m = inputs.get('modulus', 33500)
    n = inputs.get('rounds', 9)
    
    for _ in range(n):
        X = (a * X + c) % m
